text:
maria: Hey sec folks — I opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4826 that adds an on-prem auth adapter + secret rotation hook. Need a quick security sign-off before I merge tomorrow morning (timezone: PST).

kevin: Thanks — will take a look. Quick Q: does this change any network egress rules for private deployments?

maria: short answer: yes for on-prem connector. It adds an outbound TLS call to our KMS proxy for key unwrap. Details in PR description and the new file `deploy/onprem/auth_adapter.tf`.

jess: pinging HSM/keys SME thread: we should confirm KMS proxy auth flow is acceptable for air-gapped installs. Also confirm we don't surface any secret material in logs.

maria: agreed, i added logging guards, e.g. we only log status, never the key material. sample env var: `REDWOOD_ONPREM_KEY=\"<kms-ciphertext>\"` — code explicitly does not `fmt.Printf(secret)`.

ryan: dev-bot CI shows one failing unit test in `auth/rotation_test.go` related to timing; probably due to test clock. I'm running locally.

dev-bot: CI status: checks failed — unit-tests (auth) — details: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/4826/1234

audrey: also need approval from infra for the TF changes to VPC route table and the `egress_acl` rule. I left inline comments in the PR.

kevin: noted. two security items I want answered before approving: (1) threat model for compromised onprem key material (mitigations?), (2) rotation TTL and how clients discover new keys. Can you add short notes to PR?

maria: adding a small threat-model section and rotation flow to the PR body now. rotation TTL is 24h by default, with an admin override. clients poll `/v1/keys/active` with ETag support to avoid hot-polling.

jess: for air-gapped installs, make sure the KMS proxy has an option to use HSM-backed unwrap via PKCS11, not just network KMS. add config flag `KMS_USE_PKCS11=true` and document.

maria: added the `KMS_USE_PKCS11` flag and a short doc snippet under `deploy/onprem/README.md`. also added the no-log assertion in code:

```
// ensure secret never logged
log.Infof("rotation started for %s", adapter.ID)
log.Debugf("rotation: status=%s", status) // no secrets
```

sre-oncall: can you include egress destinations/ips for SOC allowlist (if customers choose to allow)? we need a minimal set.

maria: will add a small `networking.md` with IP ranges for proxy endpoints. For customers that are fully air-gapped, the docs include a manual unwrap procedure.

ryan: local test fixed, pushed a small test clock stub. re-run CI.

dev-bot: CI status: re-run queued -> all checks passed ✅

kevin: thanks — I'll do a deeper review later today. If no major issues, happy to +1. Jess, can you also eyeball the HSM bits?

jess: on it. if nothing surprising I'll approve. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all. tagging for merge window: target merge tomorrow 09:00 PST. If anyone has a hard block, say now. Otherwise I'll merge after CI and approvals. :pray:
